title: chore(version): bump algoliasearch version to v0.11.0
body: **Summary** fixes: #4916 This PR updates [`algoliasearch`](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-javascript) and `@algolia/client-search` to the latest release: [`v0.11.0`](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-javascript/releases/tag/4.11.0). This new version introduces a fix on the type of `insideBoundingBox` (see https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-javascript/pull/1310). `insideBoundingBox` used to only accept a `ReadonlyArray;`, wich was conflicting with `instantsearch.js` using it as a `string` #4916 . The fix introduced in the new @algolia/client-search packages expanded the type of `insideBoundingBox` to also accept a string ([this line](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-javascript/blob/dfa7254b1d56b7c339dde39fbb371db369d865fe/packages/client-search/src/types/SearchOptions.ts#L295)). ```ts readonly insideBoundingBox?: ReadonlyArray | string; ``` In this PR, the packages are updated and the code is made up-to-date with the introduced changes. - Typescript ignore comments to avoid typescript error are removed - Typescript workaround to enforce `string` type is removed **Result**

I made a "local" version of this PR and saw that CI is now failing for algoliasearch v3. I think we could either ts-ignore, keep the casting or keep everything as-is (except updating of course). What do you think @bidoubiwa? 

The algoliasearch (v3) types no longer exist on DefinitelyTyped, so I don't think we can add the string type there 🤔
